Review Perplexity?

Reviewers largely see Perplexity as a fast, clean research tool that often replaces traditional search for first-pass discovery, current information, and source checking. The most repeated praise is its direct answers with citations, which help users learn quickly without opening many tabs, while still giving paths for deeper verification. Some also like mobile, voice, sharing, and project organization. The main caveat is reliability: several users say citations do not always fully support claims, hallucinations still happen, and longer conversations can lose context or feel less consistent over time.

results.title: Perplexity: Where Knowledge Begins | Product Hunt
results.content:
#### What needs improvement

As a heavy user, I've noticed a few pain points. First, the recent change in how the tool handles full dialogue history seems to have slightly degraded the quality of responses in long threads. Second, when a conversation gets too long, I wish it would automatically summarize or carry the context over instead of just suggesting a new start. Lastly, I've seen some older Spaces stop working properly, which is a shame since they are great for organization. Fixing long-thread context management would make this tool perfect.

#### vs Alternatives [...] #### vs Alternatives

I chose Perplexity because I need an aggregator of intelligence, not just a chatbot. While ChatGPT and Claude are great, Perplexity gives me the best of all worlds in one interface. The transparency of citations is critical for my research, and the Deep Research mode performs better than any manual search I could do. I also love the direction the team is taking with products like the Comet browser (worthy tool!).

James Scott

#### What's great

Been using this for quick research and it feels faster than traditional search.

What stands out:  
• Answers with sources  
• Clean minimal interface  
• Good for quick learning

Still testing deeper features but so far it’s really useful for everyday questions.

#### What needs improvement [...] #### What's great

Perplexity has become my primary OS for information. I use it for hours every day, and it has almost entirely replaced other LLMs for me. It’s a true all-in-one powerhouse: from quick daily chores to deep technical research and multi-page project planning.

The UI is a masterclass in "clean focus" I love how it feels both on desktop and mobile. Features like sharing conversation links, seamless voice interaction, and the ability to switch between all top models in one place make it indispensable for my workflow. Even the image generation and file/photo analysis are surprisingly robust. It’s rare to find a tool that handles everything from shopping links to complex document summaries so gracefully.

results.content:
Postmark

They are all capable, but Resend felt like the best fit for us because it was the easiest to integrate, had the cleanest developer experience, and didn’t feel weighed down by legacy UI or unnecessary complexity.

For our use case, we wanted transactional email that was reliable, simple to configure, and easy to maintain as we build. Resend gave us that without making email feel like a separate project. The docs, API design, and dashboard all felt modern and straightforward, which made the decision pretty easy.

Jarosław Prażmo

#### What's great [...] #### What needs improvement

Deliverability guidance basically stops at "warm up your domain". When a send starts landing in spam I get clean logs saying it was delivered and nothing that helps me work out why it wasn't seen, so I end up in third party inbox placement tools. Domain and DNS setup is also still a morning of work if your registrar has an unusual DNS panel, and that's the first hour a new user spends with the product.

#### vs Alternatives

I've run SES before and the sending is cheaper, but you're building your own logs, your own retry logic and your own templating before you send anything. Resend is the one I don't think about, which for auth and receipt email is the entire requirement.

Lachlan Fleet
